records.name: Linear issue lifecycle
records.workflow: create issue → triage → prioritize → assign → cycle → review → complete.
records.states: inbox, backlog, started, blocked, canceled, duplicate, completed.
records.pattern: dense information architecture with fast state changes and low context switching.
records.recreation: a keyboard-friendly exception queue with status, owner, priority, and cycle.

records.name: Stripe payment and recovery
records.workflow: configure account → create payment → authenticate → succeed or fail → settle, refund, or dispute.
records.states: incomplete setup, pending, succeeded, failed, refunded, disputed, payout delayed.
records.pattern: event timelines and explicit next actions make invisible financial processes legible.
records.recreation: an operator payment timeline with failure explanations and recovery actions.

records.name: Airbnb reservation
records.workflow: search → filter → inspect listing → validate dates and rules → price review → reserve → prepare for stay.
records.states: unavailable dates, request pending, payment failure, cancellation, active trip, support case.
records.pattern: desire-building media is paired with repeated trust, policy, and price signals.
records.recreation: a stay-booking flow with transparent fees and a clear failed-payment recovery path.

records.name: Uber ride request
records.workflow: destination → estimate → request → matching → driver arrival → trip → payment → rating or help.
records.states: locating, searching, matched, arriving, in trip, completed, canceled, safety issue.
records.pattern: state-aware screens keep only the current decision and status prominent.
records.recreation: a service-request state machine where the primary action changes at every stage.

records.name: Instacart substitution
records.workflow: build basket → choose replacement rules → shopper picks → customer approves change → fulfill, refund, or substitute.
records.states: unavailable item, suggestion, approval pending, approved, partial fulfillment, refund, late delivery.
records.pattern: uncertainty is converted into small, understandable approval decisions.
records.recreation: a substitution card with price delta, preference, approve, and refund options.

records.name: Duolingo daily learning loop
records.workflow: choose goal → lesson → immediate feedback → progress reward → streak reminder → return.
records.states: first lesson, correct, incorrect, streak at risk, goal met, hearts depleted, upgrade prompt.
records.pattern: progress, emotion, and a tiny repeatable action reinforce retention.
records.recreation: a five-minute lesson loop with recovery after failure and a restrained upgrade moment.

records.name: Rover care booking
records.workflow: describe need → search providers → compare profile and trust signals → inquire → book → receive updates → review.
records.states: no matches, inquiry, booking request, accepted, upcoming, active care, incident, completed.
records.pattern: matching is supported by identity, availability, messaging, and evidence of care.
records.recreation: a service-provider booking flow that makes inquiry-to-confirmation transitions explicit.

records.name: Shopify order fulfillment
records.workflow: order received → allocate inventory → fulfill → label and ship → track → deliver, return, or refund.
records.states: unfulfilled, partially fulfilled, in transit, delivered, held, returned, refunded.
records.pattern: operational tables become useful when every row exposes the next action and exception.
records.recreation: a fulfillment board that highlights orders at risk rather than showing only volume.

records.name: Mobbin flow library
records.workflow: choose platform or category → search or browse → open flow → inspect screens → save or compare reference.
records.states: discovery, filters, empty search, flow detail, screen zoom, saved item, gated content.
records.pattern: the unit of value is a connected flow, not an isolated attractive screen.
records.recreation: a local reference browser that links screens into a stateful journey with annotations.

records.name: Awwwards interactive discovery
records.workflow: browse gallery → filter or open project → experience motion and interaction → inspect studio or case details.
records.states: gallery, hover, loading, transition, project detail, external visit, reduced-motion behavior.
records.pattern: visual spectacle can be organized into a navigable discovery system.
records.recreation: a small gallery with strong transitions but clear navigation and accessible fallback.

records.name: Intercom conversation routing
records.workflow: open conversation → collect context → automate or assign → respond → snooze or escalate → resolve or reopen.
records.states: bot greeting, waiting, assigned, snoozed, escalated, resolved, reopened.
records.pattern: automation and human intervention share one visible conversation context.
records.recreation: support inbox with customer context, suggested response, assignment, snooze, and reopen.

records.name: Airtable form to automation
records.workflow: publish form → collect submission → validate → create record → trigger automation → assign or notify.
records.states: blank form, validation error, submitted, duplicate, automation running, failed, assigned.
records.pattern: a simple front door can feed a structured operator workflow without exposing the database.
records.recreation: public intake form that creates an internal exception record with ownership and audit history.

records.name: Retool internal operations
records.workflow: authenticate → filter records → open detail → inspect related data → act → confirm result.
records.states: loading, stale data, permission denied, destructive confirmation, mutation success, mutation failure.
records.pattern: high-complexity internal tools can remain approachable when detail and action are colocated.
records.recreation: exception console with filterable queue, detail drawer, approval action, and audit log.

records.name: Figma collaborative handoff
records.workflow: create canvas → explore → comment → revise → approve → hand off → reuse component.
records.states: draft, editing, comment unresolved, comment resolved, review, branch, published library.
records.pattern: collaboration is embedded at the object being discussed instead of separated into another tool.
records.recreation: design-review board with object-level comments, status, and handoff checklist.

records.name: ServiceTitan field closeout
records.workflow: request → estimate → schedule → dispatch → technician work → evidence → approval → invoice → follow-up.
records.states: unscheduled, assigned, en route, on site, needs approval, parts pending, completed, ready to bill, exception.
records.pattern: the important design problem is the handoff between office certainty and field reality.
records.recreation: read-only completed-job audit that flags missing time, notes, photos, approvals, or billing status.

records.name: Buildertrend construction project
records.workflow: lead → estimate → contract → selections → schedule → budget → change order → build → punch list → warranty.
records.states: draft, awaiting selection, approval pending, scheduled, delayed, change requested, punch item open, complete.
records.pattern: client trust depends on surfacing project progress without hiding uncertainty or changes.
records.recreation: change-order and project-closeout view with version history, approval, and unresolved items.

records.name: OpenTable reservation
records.workflow: location and date → browse → filter → inspect restaurant → choose time → confirm → reminder → visit or cancel.
records.states: no availability, waitlist, reservation held, confirmed, reminder, late arrival, cancellation.
records.pattern: availability is the central interface, while trust and detail support the commitment.
records.recreation: reservation picker that handles scarcity, waitlist, confirmation, and cancellation gracefully.

records.name: Wise international transfer
records.workflow: choose currencies → enter amount → see fee and recipient amount → verify recipient → pay → track delivery.
records.states: quote, verification pending, payment pending, transfer in progress, delivered, failed, refunded.
records.pattern: transparency is a conversion feature when price, timing, and status are visible before commitment.
records.recreation: transfer quote and status tracker with fee breakdown and clear failure recovery.

records.name: Vercel deployment
records.workflow: connect project → deploy → build → inspect logs → preview → promote or roll back.
records.states: queued, building, preview ready, failed, canceled, promoted, rolled back.
records.pattern: technical progress is communicated as a timeline with logs and a clear next action.
records.recreation: deployment timeline with build stages, failure context, preview link, and rollback action.

records.name: Sentry issue triage
records.workflow: error arrives → group issue → inspect context → assign → link ticket → resolve → verify regression.
records.states: new, recurring, ignored, assigned, linked, resolved, regressed.
records.pattern: raw events become useful when grouped, contextualized, and connected to ownership.
records.recreation: error triage table with frequency, impact, owner, linked work, and regression signal.
